violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register an employee certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Soap and paper towels were not available at the hand-washing sinks in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap as well as paper towels or other hand drying provision. Paper towels and hand soap were provided at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Raw animal foods (such as sliced bacon) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as shaved parmesan) in the 2-door reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Food items were rearranged during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. The deli slicer was cleaned, sanitized, and allowed to air dry prior to returning to service. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Sliced cheeses were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Date marks were provided for food items during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the 3-door reach-in refrigerator. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/30/2026
The floor grout in the dishwashing area was observed low and is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 01/30/2027

Protective shielding is not provided for the lights in the 3-bay sink area. Light bulbs must be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 08/30/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register food safety manager with the RIDOH. Application provided during time of inspection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2024
Refrigerator door gaskets on the 3-door reach-in were observed in poor repair. Refrigerator door gaskets must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the deli slicer had an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Deli slicer was cleaned during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2024
